# Structure1 Construction

> Structure1 Construction is a licensed and insured outdoor living contractor serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex in Texas. We design and build custom patio covers, pergolas, and stamped concrete. 150+ projects completed, 2-year workmanship warranty, free on-site estimates. Website: https://structure1builds.com

## Services

- [Patio Covers](https://structure1builds.com/services/patio-covers): Gable, lean-to, and polycarbonate patio covers, $8,000–$25,000+, engineered for Texas wind with permits included
- [Concrete](https://structure1builds.com/services/concrete): Stamped concrete ($12–$22/sq ft), broom-finish driveways and patios, engineered for North Texas clay soil
- [All Services](https://structure1builds.com/services): Full service overview, including pergolas and remodels

## Key Facts

- Serves: Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Arlington, and 12+ more DFW cities
- Patio covers typically cost $8,000–$25,000+ in DFW; most projects complete in 2–4 weeks
- Stamped concrete runs $12–$22 per square foot installed in DFW
- Permits and engineering are handled by Structure1 in every DFW municipality
- All structures built with Western Red Cedar on steel-anchored, engineered footings
- 2-year workmanship warranty on every project; free itemized estimates
